Assalam-U-Alaikum. I want to know whether there is a permission in Islam to purchase a car on Installments. As per my knowledge, under installment scheme, you are supposed to pay the actual cost fixed intrest per month. But the cost is predecided by the bank for eg. if the vehicle cost is 4 lakhs, and if you are paying the installments in 3 years, bank will calculate the intrest and give you the final figure of 5.5 lakhs. So the cost of the car is 5.5 lakhs for you, which you are supposed to pay in 3 years. But if you change your plan of making payment in 4 years, then the total value of car will increase. So Please let me know whether we can purchase a car on installment. I can not buy a car by paying entire amount in cash, and car is very important for me to buy. Will be thankful to you for your advise. 2157 views Q. Is use of Credit Card is permissible in Islam? What if I don't pay interest on it and pay the dues within given time period? 10779 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 1729 Country: India Title: A muslim brother is running a scheme. for example he collects one thousand ruppees from ten members monthly.on a paticular day he does qurra.the name which comes in the qurra will be given ten thousnad rupees.he collects one hundred rupees from person as ujrat.no interest what so ever.is this permissable. Question: A muslim brother is running a scheme. for example he collects one thousand ruppees from ten members monthly.on a paticular day he does qurra.the name which comes in the qurra will be given ten thousnad rupees.he collects one hundred rupees from person as ujrat.no interest what so ever.is this permissable. Answer ID: 1729 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 725/721=N) In this scheme, ten members give one thousand rupees for ten months, and each month the collected amount is handed over to a person in whose name the lot is drawn. This is allowed. But, what kind of charge it is (in form of one hundred rupees) which is received from every member? Please, describe it clearly then in-sha-Allah you shall be given an accurate reply about this scheme. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
